name: Kendamar
description: Kendamar was a terrestrial planet located in the Kendamar system, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Lol sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Kendamari Casinos, a chain of casinos that constituted a part of the Tenloss Syndicate.
